question: What does the editor draw while a block is held, what do the center line and the matching flags look like, and is there a center snap?
how: real mouse input in headless Chrome on the demo page; the section's blocks: heading 15917 at 1/2/5/16, paragraph 16145 at 3/2/8/13, shape 16395 at 2/15/12/25. Nothing was saved: every run ended with Exit Without Saving. Earlier probes looked for class names with guide in them and found 0: the class names are hashed.

held.block: keeps its own z-index and opacity 1: a paragraph (z 2) held over the shape (z 3) stays behind it
held.selectionRingAndHandles: gone while held, for drag and resize
held.cursor: grabbing on the grid and everything inside it, for drag and resize; body stays auto

targetRing.outer: 3px solid rgb(72, 148, 255) on a box 3px outside the target area
targetRing.inner: 2px solid rgb(2, 122, 255) on a box 2px outside the target area
targetRing.group: one ring around the target areas of all blocks in the group: 1 / 4 / 8 / 18 for the heading and paragraph

centerLine.where: a child of the section, full section height, behind the blocks. Phones have it too, but only while it is yellow, at any window width (HOLD.json corrects the first reading here, one hold at 428px away from the center)
centerLine.shown: while a block is held, for drag, resize and group, only in its own section

centerSnap.rule: desktop and phones (HOLD.json), one block: a block of an odd width cannot center on line 14, so while its center is within half a column of the canvas center the target takes one more column, centered. The block shows the wider size, and a drop stores it. An even width centers as it is. A resize only turns the line yellow: it does not stretch.
centerSnap.edges: 14 drag holds of the shape over the section (columns -13 to 1, rows -1 to 3): no yellow other than the center line. A drag does not snap to other blocks' edges beyond the grid, and sets no matching flag.

width.resize: shape east handle, one column, to 2 / 15 / 12 / 26, as wide as the paragraph
width.bar: the top border of the layer, 3px and its inner 2px
width.ticks: 3 by 16px, at the left and right ends, starting 6px above the layer
width.on: the target ring and the matching block

height.resize: shape south handle, 5 rows, to 2 / 15 / 7 / 25, as tall as the paragraph
height.bar: the left border of the layer, 3px and its inner 2px
height.ticks: 16 by 3px, at the top and bottom ends, starting 6px left of the layer
height.on: the target ring and the matching block

layer.target: the target ring, 3px outside the area, ticks at [855.3, 290.5] and [855.3, 488] for a ring at [861.3, 290.5, 582.8, 200.5]
layer.other: a layer exactly on the block, z 100000 + its z, ticks at [94.1, 334.6] and [94.1, 526.1] for a block at [100.1, 334.6, 635.6, 194.5]

nearRing.only: during a resize; a drag sets the flag and draws nothing
nearRing.rings: 1px rgba(2, 122, 255, 0.49) just outside the block, 1px rgba(72, 148, 255, 0.7) around that
nearRing.self: the resized block has no ring

oddGroup: all three blocks, 23 columns: 1 / 2 / 12 / 25 up to dx 29, then 1 / 3 / 12 / 26; the line stayed dashed and no block changed width, so a group does not stretch
notMeasured: the marks on other block types than text and shape
